identityConvention: Actual exported r09 body vertex rows equal eye-audit.npz after rows. Face IDs are exported triangle rows, never native Blender polygon IDs. Eye vertex/triangle IDs belong to the named eye mesh.
limits: Diagnosis only; r09 remains an intermediate with visually unacceptable rim wrinkles.
Projection reversals are relative to the outward eye-view direction; they locate folds/overhangs, not changes in topological winding.
Open3D pair detections are counted separately from independently confirmed strict edge/triangle crossings. Shared-vertex pairs can be omitted.
Signed distances sample eye vertices against the closed body. Near-zero values and signs close to folded surfaces have numerical limits; this is not a complete minimum-clearance certificate.
No geometry, target coordinates or Blender changes are authored.
